branches.predicate: decode f32 subnormal magnitude into f64

branches.predicate: sign bit selects the signed decoded subnormal
branches.tie: the sign bit selects negative including a negative subnormal; zero is handled by the cast arm

branches.predicate: pack a finite f64 magnitude below the smallest normal f32

refusal.record_type: int32 device slots, zero before launch and inspect after synchronization; host builds AdFailureRecord
refusal.producer: one slot per source ID; atomicExch sets a deterministic refusal flag; no floating-point atomics

admission: All dimensions are positive and all products fit signed 32-bit forward indexing.
Field buffers are contiguous, disjoint, sized for declared shapes, and the primal output buffers contain the completed unmodified forward result.
Each cells_on_edge endpoint is in range; the derived CSR enumerates each distinct incident edge once per cell, in ascending edge order.
The forward launch is one-dimensional (grid.y=grid.z=block.y=block.z=1) and has positive grid.x and block.x. It covers all output words: grid.x*block.x >= nlev*nedges.
adjoint_accumulation: Exclusive input-owned gathers in fixed topology order; no unordered atomics. After a block barrier the overwritten output cotangents are consumed and zeroed.
geometry_policy: fixed mesh geometry and topology; all floating dynamic state inputs are active
primal_arithmetic: Compile TL/AD with fused multiply-add disabled. Use --ftz=true for fast captured forward images and --ftz=false for strict images, preserving all other options; no augmented forward is needed because the original primal arrays are retained. See COMMON-AD 70.2.

integration_limitations.section_33_launch_abi: section 33 entry bindings supplied; integration must support the separate branch artifact
integration_limitations.section_33_branch_record: The branch helper and instrumented probe agree on the captured fast inputs; the probe output agrees bitwise with the original RRFS forward. Guarded arithmetic sites are compiled out in fast mode. Strict-mode one-sided and crossing cases are reported on forced inputs using aggregate records; independent per-lane branch coverage is not established.
integration_limitations.extra_topology: The inverse incidence is constructed from this forward's cells_on_edge alone, including regional halo endpoints; the runner must support the derived binding.
integration_limitations.adjoint_launch: Use one CUDA block for the reverse gather and output-cotangent consumption; the entry refuses any other grid.
integration_limitations.forward_launch_coverage: The binder must validate the full-overwrite launch coverage stated in admission before using these entries. Undercovered pressure or chunk launches leave some forward output slots unchanged, but these full-domain entries do not implement partial-overwrite derivatives.

independent_helper_validation.scope: Synthetic per-lane comparison of the source helper predicates and instrumented branch helper; full strict row execution is not independently traced.

rounding.tie: exact halfway values round to an even integer mantissa
rounding.reason: rounding operation, not a branch predicate

launch_abi.branch_helper_order: run branch before derivative or independently for base and each perturbation

duplicate_cotangents: Contributions to each shared f32 input are gathered in fixed order into an f64 register, then rounded once when accumulated into the f32 adjoint; COMMON-AD section 40.
branch_numerics: Compile the branch entry with the forward route options: fast defines MPAS_FTZ_FALLBACK_ENABLED=0 and has no guarded-helper predicates; strict enables and records them.

ledger_resolution.note: Inactive means the indexed control or loop decision is fixed. Selected values marked active remain differentiated.
